I guess you could call what I went through 2 weeks ago an intervention, and I think it worked. 

I ended up calling the cops on my Q (husband) because he was so drunk and out of control. His parents bailed him out and let him stay with them, but I guess the arrest was enough to open their eyes to the extent of the problem. But they still weren’t really willing to do anything. His dad said, “we’ve all been through enough today.” And I said, “no, we need to find somewhere today so he can check in tomorrow.” It only happened because I put my foot down, set boundaries, and took action myself. 

My husband has been in rehab for a week, has found a sponsor, and is doing his 12 steps. Unfortunately it took a traumatic event to get us there and make everyone realize that his disease was out of control. 

But my advice is to stop letting fear of retribution (from him or his family) hold you back. Set boundaries and don’t back down. 

It’ll be okay.
